_purpose: Pre-holdout architecture freeze manifest, LNES-59. From this commit forward, no architecture changes are authorized based on holdout outcomes -- if a fatal benchmark-infrastructure defect is found post-freeze, it is recorded and the affected run is invalidated if necessary, not silently patched. Matches the LNES-58 frozen-evidence-v1 precedent (LNES59_GROUND_TRUTH_MANIFEST.json is the analogous DATASET freeze; this is the CODE freeze).

explicitly_not_frozen.cases.json / cases_batch2.json / cases_b: dataset content, not architecture -- scaling to 150 cases (directive Phase 5) adds MORE of these under the frozen rules, does not modify frozen code
explicitly_not_frozen.run_case.py, arm_x2.py, run_x2_arm.py, m: harness/runner code -- may still change to support new arms (X0, X1, B0-B4) without re-opening the frozen gate/extraction/schema logic
explicitly_not_frozen.test_*.py: test files may grow (new cases need new fixtures) but must not be used to justify changing frozen behavior -- a new failing test against frozen code is a finding to record, not a license to patch the freeze

gate._version_note: 2.0 = original 9-outcome gate (commit ce69ea2 era). 2.1 = this freeze -- adds values_match() (taxonomy #16), the INCOMPLETE asserted_value=None carve-out (taxonomy #15), _claims_beyond_scope() replacing exact-equality scope comparison, and historical_values lineage checking (taxonomy #17-18). The git_commit field above is the authoritative version identifier; this string is a human-readable label, not independently verified.

extraction._version_note: 1.0 = original (commit ce69ea2 era). 1.1 = predicate-aware scoping + PO issued-date fallback + real policy_tiers (taxonomy #14, commit e4bc6ac). 1.2 = this freeze -- adds _derive_scope() and historical_values collection (taxonomy #17-18). Same caveat as gate.version above.
